reasoning: This is the standard camera exposure-compensation symbol (with minus and plus in a diagonally split square), also read more broadly as pros/cons, delta, or basic addition/subtraction. It fits niche photography editing tasks and pros-and-cons decision tasks, though general users may confuse it with a generic math or calculator icon.
